qa_questions.question: Can Asteria use the Atlas Business Corpus in a commercial product?
qa_questions.expected_answer: No. Internal non-production research and evaluation only; commercial use is prohibited.
qa_questions.expected_citation: Licensee may use the Licensed Data solely for internal, non-production research and evaluation purposes.

qa_questions.question: May HelixLM be deployed to customers through Asteria's hosted service?
qa_questions.expected_answer: Yes, through Asteria's hosted service, without distributing model weights.
qa_questions.expected_citation: Licensor grants Licensee the right to deploy the Model as part of Licensee's hosted commercial services.

qa_questions.question: When is the VectorGrid usage report due?
qa_questions.expected_answer: Within 15 calendar days after each calendar quarter.
qa_questions.expected_citation: Within fifteen (15) calendar days after each calendar quarter, Customer shall provide a usage report.

qa_questions.question: How does the Horizon Bank subscription renew?
qa_questions.expected_answer: Automatic 12-month renewals unless either party gives 60 days' written notice.
qa_questions.expected_citation: The Subscription automatically renews for successive twelve-month periods unless either party gives at least sixty (60) days' written notice.

qa_questions.question: Does the current data room prove that OCRVision API may be used commercially?
qa_questions.expected_answer: No conclusion. No executed OCRVision agreement is present.
